summary.text: Matt Commons is a Republican member of the Indiana House of Representatives who has represented District 13 since November 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a U.S. Army veteran.

paragraphs.text: Commons was born in Bedford, Indiana, and served in the U.S. Army from 2009 to 2014.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was raised in Warren County, graduated from Seeger High School before enlisting, completed two tours in Afghanistan, and received a Purple Heart after being wounded in combat.
Commons took office in the Indiana House on November 6, 2024, succeeding Sharon Negele.
In the 2024 survey he listed local community control, constitutional rights and freedom, and fiscal responsibility as his key messages.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.
